text: My daily routine is simple but well organised. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. In the evening, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park, because exercise helps me relax and stay healthy. Later, I have dinner and spend some time reading or watching TV. I try to go to bed before eleven. I believe consistency is the key to a good routine.
